groups.defect: The unconditional postgres skip disables the instrumentation-server integration test, removing its regression coverage in CI and local postgres runs.
groups.rationale: Both report the same added skip as the defect. Their emphasis on startup coverage versus instrumentation behavior and local execution describes consequences of disabling the same test.

groups.defect: Removing build-wide synchronization permits concurrent same-key index builds to collide on the Bleve directory and overwrite cached indexes, leaking the losing index.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same synchronization removal and the same directory and cache races. The stale-snapshot consequence and caller details elaborate that shared defect; per-key build coordination addresses both.
